svg.text: MMIO Address Decoder & Bus Multiplexer (1 Master ➔ 5 Dedicated Slaves)
MMIO Address: 0x1000_0000 - 0x1000_0004 | Bus Select: sel_rfid | 9600 Baud (CLK_DIV=5208)
★ Giải mã khung 14-byte & Checksum XOR thực hiện trong C Firmware (firmware/protocol/rdm6300_parser.c)
SLAVE 3: rtl/uart/uart_mmio.v [u_host_uart] (Host PC UART MMIO Module)
MMIO Address: 0x3000_0000 - 0x3000_0004 | Bus Select: sel_uart | Full-Duplex (CLK_DIV=5208)
★ Giao tiếp 11 lệnh Host PC, truyền nhận nhị phân & chuỗi Wiegand/Dec/Hex an toàn không mất gói
Cấu trúc mô-đun chuẩn hóa: rtl/core/ (CPU PicoRV32, 1KB SRAM, Flash XIP spimemio, Interconnect, GPIO) | rtl/uart/ (Dual Unified UART MMIO với FIFO 32B: u_rfid_uart & u_host_uart)
